title: Animal Welfare and Policy Risk Index (AWPRI): Constructing a Cross-National Exposure Measure of Livestock and Aquatic Animal Use and Governance Capacity, 24 Countries, 2010-2022
abstract: arXiv:2603.22356v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This research paper introduces the Animal Welfare and Policy Risk Index (AWPRI), a composite exposure index covering livestock and aquatic animals used for food in 24 countries over 2010-2022 (N = 312 country-year observations, 3,744 observed values, no imputed values). The AWPRI measures animal-use exposure and governance capacity relative to the panel, not animal welfare outcomes. The AWPRI is constructed from 12 variables organised across three layers, namely Animal-use exposure (L1), Governance capacity (L2), and artificial intelligence amplification (L3). Each layer is the mean of its own variables and the composite is the mean of the three layers, so a variable sitting in the three-variable layer carries more weight than one sitting in the five-variable layer. Variables are min-max normalised within each year, so a country's value on any variable, layer, or composite suggests its position among the 24 countries that year. K-mea

translated_title: 动物福利与政策风险指数（AWPRI）：构建2010-2022年24国畜禽与水生动物使用及治理能力的跨国暴露度测量指标
translated_abstract: 本研究论文提出了动物福利与政策风险指数（AWPRI），这是一个覆盖2010-2022年间24个国家用于食品的畜禽和水生动物的综合暴露度指数（N = 312个国家-年度观测值，3,744个观测值，无插补值）。AWPRI衡量的是相对于面板数据的动物使用暴露度和治理能力，而非动物福利结果。AWPRI由12个变量构成，分为三个层次：动物使用暴露度（L1）、治理能力（L2）和人工智能放大（L3）。每个层次取其自身变量的平均值，综合指数取三个层次的平均值，因此位于三变量层次中的变量比位于五变量层次中的变量具有更大的权重。变量在每年内进行最小-最大归一化处理，因此一个国家在任何变量、层次或综合指数上的数值反映了其当年在24个国家中的相对位置。K-mea
tldr: 该论文构建了动物福利与政策风险指数（AWPRI），这是一个由12个变量、三个层次组成的跨国综合指数，用于衡量2010-2022年间24个国家畜禽与水生动物的食品使用暴露度及治理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs the Animal Welfare and Policy Risk Index (AWPRI), a cross-national composite index with 12 variables across three layers measuring livestock and aquatic animal-use exposure and governance capacity in 24 countries from 2010 to 2022.
